questions: Does 'first occurrence' mean the first occurrence in the document order as parsed by BeautifulSoup, or the first occurrence at the top-level of the HTML tree (ignoring nesting)?
Should the function follow redirects automatically (requests.get default behavior) or treat redirects as errors?
Is the tag parameter case-sensitive? Should 'DIV' match a '<div>' tag?
Should the function raise an exception for network errors (like requests.get does) or return None?

Does 'handling nested tags of the same type as a single occurrence' mean we should skip nested same-type tags when searching for the first occurrence, or just that when extracting text, nested same-type tags are included?
Should the function set a timeout or retry policy for the HTTP request?
Does 'text content' include only visible text, or also script/style tag contents?
Should the function validate the URL scheme (e.g., allow only http/https) before making a request?
